title: THE WID
intro: Planned to open in 2026, located in Senja, Norway. The area is known for its striking landscapes.

title: Portal Berlin
intro: At a place shaped by urban transformation, this building makes a statement with a sense of history. Its entrance does more than open — it welcomes, guiding visitors from the city’s rhythm into a calm and ordered interior.

title: Hinwil
intro: A replacement courthouse in Hinwil, Switzerland, designed with a clear contemporary character while respecting its civic role. A concise, modern structure that lends the site a renewed and confident presence.

title: Mainau Insel
intro: Mainau Island is defined by constant transformation — a natural cycle of growth and change. This idea extends to its architecture, where temporary structures are not defects but adaptive, resilient elements with their own aesthetic. The island feels complete at every moment, with transitions understood as part of its inherent logic.

title: Stadtallendorf
intro: A remodel and extension transform this mixed-use building into a home with flowing transitions between inside and outside. A new garden-facing addition, rooftop terrace, and open living spaces create a generous family residence above the existing commercial area.

title: Farmsen
intro: A large, green residential district organized around a central park and lake, featuring curved building layouts, dense tree corridors, and sculptural red towers. The masterplan blends housing, landscape, and public spaces into a cohesive urban environment.

title: Campus Kartause Köln
intro: Drawing from the historic Carthusian monastery, the design preserves its spirit by creating a place that is both welcoming to the Südstadt and quietly cloister-like inside. The project mediates between dense urban blocks and the monastery’s orthogonal order, using clear forms, framed views, and consistent materials to establish a timeless and calm architectural presence.

title: Königstraße
intro: A new office building forms a clear urban landmark at Martin-Luther-Platz, strengthening the square’s identity and connecting smoothly to its surroundings. Its refined façade, flexible interiors, and green terraces create a contemporary and enduring addition to the cityscape.

title: Köln Ehrenfeld
intro: A careful balance of old and new defines this transformation. The restored Art Nouveau façade meets a refined garden-side extension with shimmering metal shingles, unified by consistent design. A green roof terrace and wide seating steps create a seamless flow between interior and garden, forming a harmonious contemporary addition.

title: Marburg
intro: Reimagining the old brings light, air, and greenery back into the neighborhood. This project sets a clear, sustainable impulse in Marburg’s station district — redefining how living, working, leisure, and mobility can come together in a future-oriented urban setting.

title: Schlägelstraße
intro: Located directly next to Düsseldorf Central Station, this office building combines a robust brick architecture with generous green spaces. A landscaped rooftop terrace and a planted inner courtyard create relaxing outdoor areas, adding light and nature to an otherwise urban setting.

title: Burgfelderstrasse
intro: Created on a former tram loop site, this project provides around 32 social housing units along with a double kindergarten and day-care facilities. The listed tram pavilion is thoughtfully integrated, turning an obsolete transport area into meaningful, community-oriented space.

title: Boutanique
intro: A boutique for botany: this concept store combines flowers, plants, décor, a greenhouse, a café, and a flowerschool under one roof. A flowing pink terrazzo counter links all areas, while lush hanging greenery and raw concrete surfaces create a vivid contrast and a dynamic, creative atmosphere.

title: Terra Calma
intro: Terra Calma sits close enough to the sea to hear the waves, while its hillside position offers wide inland views. A sheltered terrace with barbecue and seating lies at the rear, with a second garden level below — generous outdoor spaces for shared moments or quiet retreat.

title: Königstraße
intro: A new office building forms a clear urban landmark at Martin-Luther-Platz, strengthening the square’s identity and connecting smoothly to its surroundings. Its refined façade, flexible interiors, and green terraces create a contemporary and enduring addition to the cityscape.

title: Kloster Eberbach
intro: Kloster Eberbach is a historic Cistercian monastery in the Rheingau, preserved and managed by a public foundation dedicated to protecting this cultural landmark. Through restoration, cultural programs, events, and public access, the foundation works to keep the site’s heritage alive while shaping its future and fostering dialogue.

title: Sarnen
intro: A new replacement building in Sarnen is planned as a versatile community center. It will include a larger church hall with stage, a flexible multipurpose room, a welcoming foyer, a central café with kitchen, as well as spaces for childcare, teaching, and creative work.

title: Columbarium church in Emden
intro: The design keeps the church as a clear, unified space while giving each zone its own calm character. The raised choir becomes the worship area, with simple wooden furnishings and a cross-shaped light relief. A bronzed screen separates it from the columbarium, where four sculptural crosses hold the urns and create a dignified, contemplative atmosphere.
